inspect.label: inspect
inspect.help: You can read what was recorded. No bodies were kept, so nothing can be replayed.

view.label: view
view.help: You can read what the agent asked, what the model returned, and what each tool was called with and returned.

fork.label: fork
fork.help: You can branch from any frame and run on, with tool results served from the recording.

retry.label: retry
retry.help: You can run the recording again and get the same frames.

readFailure.denied: You cannot see {section} in this workspace. Your roles do not include {permission}; an organization owner can grant it.
readFailure.deniedByRule: You cannot see {section} in this workspace. The decision rule {rule} refused this read. A workspace admin can change the rule.
readFailure.pendingApproval: Access to {section} is waiting for approval, request {accessRequestId}.
readFailure.error: {section} could not be loaded: the control plane answered {code}. Nothing was changed, and runs kept recording.

mandateBar.title: Remaining authority · {measure} · {period} · {periodKey}
mandateBar.label: {measure}: {settled} settled, {remaining} remaining of {limit}
mandateBar.labelReserved: {measure}: {settled} settled, {reserved} reserved by calls in flight, {remaining} remaining of {limit}
mandateBar.overLimit: Drawn authority is past this limit: the ledger holds more than the limit now allows, which is what lowering a limit does to authority already drawn. The settled and reserved figures say where it sits.

sourceFilename.name: Source name
sourceFilename.hint: Enter to apply. Escape to cancel. This updates the name in the source.
sourceFilename.invalid: Use a valid lowercase name with hyphens, and check that the source can be read.

error.title: This page could not be loaded
error.body: The control plane answered {answer}. Nothing was changed. Runs kept recording while this page was down. Frames are written by the collector on each host, not by Oxagen.
error.incidentNotBacked: Oxagen cannot open an incident from this page yet.

denied.body: Your roles on {org} do not include {permission}. An organization owner can grant it; the grant is a governed action and lands in the audit record with your name on it.
denied.requestNotBacked: Oxagen cannot send a request for a role yet.
denied.policyNotRecorded: policy not recorded · deny wins over every allow

notFound.title: No page has this address
notFound.bodyWorkspace: Nothing in workspace {ws} is at {path}. The link may be mistyped, or the run, agent or record it names may not exist.
notFound.bodyOrganization: Nothing in organization {org} is at {path}. The link may be mistyped, or the record it names may not exist.

desktopDownloads.title: Install the Oxagen app
desktopDownloads.lead: Install it first, on the machine the agent runs on. The app puts the oxagen and tacho commands on PATH, and enrollment runs through them.
desktopDownloads.macosFirstLaunch: macOS refuses the first launch until builds are notarized. Choose Done, then click Open Anyway in System Settings > Privacy & Security.

picker.failed: The list could not be loaded.
picker.more: {count, plural, one {# more match} other {# more matches}}. Keep typing to narrow the list.
picker.partial: This list shows the first page only. Type to narrow it.
picker.failedFreeform: The list could not be loaded. You can still type a value.

removeHints.agent: Use the agent's default initials instead.
removeHints.workspace: Use the workspace's default initials instead.
removeHints.organization: Use the organization's default initials instead.

avatarEditor.iconHint: Lucide glyphs, the set the product ships. One line weight, drawn in the tone's ink.
avatarEditor.photoHint: An https link to a hosted image: PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG.
avatarEditor.toneHint: Solid, soft, and line follow the theme. Gold and dark gold are the brand gold in two shades. Each tone fixes its own glyph colour, so there is no combination that fails.

notes.user: Saved with update_profile, like any change to your account.
notes.agent: Part of the agent's definition, so a change rides a pull request.
notes.workspace: Saved with update_workspace_settings on the workspace's record.
notes.organization: Saved with update_org_settings on the organization's record.

avatarEditor.noPhoto: Paste an https link to a photo first, or switch to an icon or initials.
avatarEditor.invalid: That avatar was refused. A photo link must be an https address under 512 characters.

denied.user: You do not have permission to change this profile.
denied.agent: You do not have permission to change this agent.
denied.workspace: You do not have permission to change this workspace.
denied.organization: You do not have permission to change this organization.

avatarEditor.failed: That could not be saved. Try again.
